```{r}
obj <- readRDS(params$reboot_object)
obj_class <- class(obj)[1]

is_regression <- obj_class == "reboot_signature"
is_survival <- obj_class == "reboot_survival"
is_complete <- obj_class == "reboot_complete"

reg <- if (is_complete) obj$regression else if (is_regression) obj else NULL
surv <- if (is_complete) obj$survival else if (is_survival) obj else NULL

safe_print <- function(x){
  try(print(x), silent = TRUE)
}

num_summary <- function(x){
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (length(x) == 0)
  {
    return(c(
      Minimum = NA_real_,
      Median = NA_real_,
      Mean = NA_real_,
      Maximum = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  c(
    Minimum = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Maximum = max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

emit_table <- function(df, caption = NULL, digits = 4, font_size = 12, scale_down = FALSE)
{
  tbl <- knitr::kable(df, caption = caption, digits = digits, booktabs = TRUE,
                      format = ifelse(knitr::is_latex_output(), "latex", "html"))

  if (requireNamespace("kableExtra", quietly = TRUE))
  {
    if (knitr::is_latex_output())
    {
      latex_options <- "HOLD_position"
      if (scale_down) {latex_options <- c(latex_options, "scale_down")}

      tbl <- kableExtra::kable_styling(tbl,
                                       latex_options = latex_options,
                                       font_size = font_size)
    } else {
      tbl <- kableExtra::kable_styling(tbl,
                                       bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                                       full_width = TRUE, font_size = font_size)
    }
  }

  cat(tbl, sep = "\n")
}

params_to_df <- function(x)
{
  data.frame(
    Parameter = names(x),
    Value = sapply(x, function(v)
    {
      if (is.null(v)) {"NULL"} else {paste(v, collapse = ", ")}
    }),
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

call_to_text <- function(x)
{
  paste(deparse(x), collapse = "\n")
}

status_label <- function(x)
{
  ifelse(x == 0, "Alive / censored", ifelse(x == 1, "Dead / event", as.character(x)))
}

infer_followup_years <- function(x)
{
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

  if (all(is.na(x)))
  {
    return(x)
  }

  max_x <- max(x, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (max_x > 100)
  {
    return(x / 365.25)
  }

  if (max_x > 20)
  {
    return(x / 12)
  }

  x
}
```

# Overview

This report provides an automated summary of the REBOOT analysis, including model parameters, generated signatures, score-based survival stratification, Cox regression results, diagnostic plots, and key descriptive statistics. The goal is to provide a compact, reproducible, and interpretable record of the analysis workflow and its main outputs.

</div>
```

# Module I - Regression

```{r}
#| results: asis

if (!is.null(reg)) {

  cat("## Function call\n\n")
  cat("```r\n")
  cat(call_to_text(reg$call), "\n")
  cat("```\n\n")

  cat("## Parameters\n\n")
  emit_table(
    params_to_df(reg$params),
    caption = "Regression module parameters",
    digits = 4
  )

  cat("\n\n## Signature\n\n")
  emit_table(
    reg$signature,
    caption = "Generated signature",
    digits = 4
  )

  cat("\n\n## Signature statistics\n\n")
  stats_df <- data.frame(
    Statistic = "Coefficient",
    t(num_summary(reg$signature$coefficient)),
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  emit_table(
    stats_df,
    caption = "Coefficient summary statistics",
    digits = 4
  )

  cat("\n\nNumber of selected features:", nrow(reg$signature), "\n\n")
}
```

# Module II - Survival

```{r}
#| results: asis

if (!is.null(surv)) {

  cat("## Function call\n\n")
  cat("```r\n")
  cat(call_to_text(surv$call), "\n")
  cat("```\n\n")

  cat("## Parameters\n\n")
  emit_table(
    params_to_df(surv$params),
    caption = "Survival module parameters",
    digits = 4
  )

  cat("\n\n## Updated signature\n\n")
  emit_table(
    surv$signature,
    caption = "Updated signature",
    digits = 4
  )

  cat("\n\n## Signature statistics\n\n")
  surv_sig_stats <- data.frame(
    Statistic = "Coefficient",
    t(num_summary(surv$signature$coefficient)),
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  emit_table(
    surv_sig_stats,
    caption = "Updated signature coefficient summary statistics",
    digits = 4
  )

  cat("\n\n## Score cutoff\n\n")
  score_cutoff_df <- data.frame(
    Metric = "Score cutoff",
    Value = surv$score_cutoff
  )

  emit_table(
    score_cutoff_df,
    caption = "Score cutoff used for patient stratification",
    digits = 4
  )

  cat("\n\n## Score statistics\n\n")
  score_stats <- data.frame(
    Statistic = "Score",
    t(num_summary(surv$expression_data$score)),
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  emit_table(
    score_stats,
    caption = "Score summary statistics",
    digits = 4
  )

  cat("\n\n## Clinical variables\n\n")
  clinical_vars <- setdiff(colnames(surv$clinical_data),
                           c("OS", "OS.time", "score", "score_group"))

  clinical_df <- data.frame(Variable = clinical_vars,
                            Categories = sapply(surv$clinical_data[, clinical_vars,
                                                                   drop = FALSE],
                                                function(x) {length(unique(stats::na.omit(x)))}),
                            Values = sapply(surv$clinical_data[, clinical_vars,
                                                                   drop = FALSE],
                                                function(x)
                                                {
                                                  paste(unique(stats::na.omit(x)),
                                                        collapse = ", ")
                                                }), row.names = NULL)

  emit_table(
    clinical_df,
    caption = "Clinical variables available for survival analysis",
    digits = 4
  )

  cat("\n\n## Univariate Cox table\n\n")
  uni_table <- surv$survival$univariate$table
  rownames(uni_table) <- NULL
  emit_table(uni_table, caption = "Univariate Cox model",
             digits = 4, font_size = 7, scale_down = TRUE)

  if (!is.null(surv$survival$multivariate))
  {
    cat("\n\n## Multivariate Cox table\n\n")
    emit_table(
      surv$survival$multivariate$table,
      caption = "Multivariate Cox model",
      digits = 4,
      font_size = 7,
      scale_down = TRUE
    )
  }

  cat("\n\n## Proportional hazards table\n\n")
  emit_table(
    surv$ph_result$table,
    caption = "Proportional hazards test",
    digits = 4
  )
}
```

# Survival Data Summary

```{r}
#| results: asis

if (!is.null(surv)) {

  os_df <- as.data.frame(table(status_label(surv$clinical_data$OS)))
  colnames(os_df) <- c("Status", "Count")

  emit_table(
    os_df,
    caption = "Overall survival status",
    digits = 4
  )

  followup_years <- infer_followup_years(surv$clinical_data$OS.time)

  followup_df <- data.frame(
    Followup = c("<= 1 year", "<= 3 years", "<= 5 years", "<= 10 years"),
    Count = c(
      sum(followup_years <= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(followup_years <= 3, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(followup_years <= 5, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(followup_years <= 10, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

  emit_table(
    followup_df,
    caption = "Follow-up time summary",
    digits = 4
  )

  followup_stats <- data.frame(
    Statistic = "OS.time (years)",
    t(num_summary(followup_years)),
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  emit_table(
    followup_stats,
    caption = "Follow-up summary statistics",
    digits = 4
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of overall survival status."

if (!is.null(surv)) {

  os_df <- as.data.frame(table(status_label(surv$clinical_data$OS)))
  colnames(os_df) <- c("Status", "Count")
  
  os_df$Percent <- round(100 * os_df$Count / sum(os_df$Count), 1)
  os_df$Label <- paste0(os_df$Count, " (", os_df$Percent, "%)")

  ggplot2::ggplot(os_df, ggplot2::aes(x = "", y = Count, fill = Status)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
    ggplot2::coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = Label),
                       position = ggplot2::position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 4) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4E79A7", "#E15759")) +
    ggplot2::theme_void() +
    ggplot2::labs(title = "OS distribution", fill = "Status")
}
```

```{r}

if (!is.null(surv) && !is.null(surv$roc_result)) {

  roc_df <- data.frame(
    Cutoff = surv$roc_result$cutoff,
    AUC = surv$roc_result$auc,

```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-cap: "ROC curve."

if (!is.null(surv) && !is.null(surv$roc_result$optimal_cutpoint$data)) {

  roc_data <- surv$roc_result$optimal_cutpoint$data

  roc_obj <- pROC::roc(response = roc_data$OS, predictor = roc_data$score,
    direction = surv$roc_result$direction, quiet = TRUE)

  roc_df <- data.frame(Specificity = rev(roc_obj$specificities),
                       Sensitivity = rev(roc_obj$sensitivities))

  roc_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(roc_df, ggplot2::aes(x = 1 - Specificity, y = Sensitivity)) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "blue") +
    ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "gray") +
    ggplot2::coord_equal() + ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black"),
                   axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black")) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = "ROC curve",
                  subtitle = paste0("AUC = ", round(surv$roc_result$auc, 3)),
                  x = "1 - Specificity", y = "Sensitivity")
  
  print(roc_plot)
}
```
